SaffronCity_HomeD_Text_Ask.en: ROUTE TOURNAMENT. Beat one trainer\non each of ten routes: R3, R4, R24,\pR25, R6, R11, R9, R10, R8, R12.\nThen face the ROUTE KING.
SaffronCity_HomeD_Text_Ask.fr: TOURNOI DES ROUTES. Bats un\ndresseur sur chacune de dix\lroutes : R3, R4, R24,\pR25, R6, R11, R9, R10, R8, R12.\nPuis affronte le ROI DES ROUTES.

SaffronCity_HomeD_Text_Beaten.en: The crown is yours... for now.
SaffronCity_HomeD_Text_Beaten.fr: La couronne est à toi… pour\nl'instant.

SaffronCity_HomeD_Text_Done.en: You are the ROUTE KING. The routes\nwill remember.
SaffronCity_HomeD_Text_Done.fr: Tu es le ROI DES ROUTES. Les routes\ns'en souviendront.

SaffronCity_HomeD_Text_NoRoom.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
SaffronCity_HomeD_Text_NoRoom.fr: Ton SAC est plein ! Fais de la\nplace et reviens me voir.

SaffronCity_HomeD_Text_Prize.en: A new KING of the routes! Here,\nyour prize.
SaffronCity_HomeD_Text_Prize.fr: Un nouveau ROI des routes ! Tiens,\nton prix.

SaffronCity_HomeD_Text_Ready.en: Ten routes, ten victories. The KING\nis waiting. Ready?
SaffronCity_HomeD_Text_Ready.fr: Dix routes, dix victoires. Le ROI\nt'attend. Prêt ?
